selection_status: Pre-schematic component selections, calculated circuits and bounded initial fixtures; not a released assembly BOM.
quantity_scope: Counts cover this field I/O sheet only, including off-board mating plugs/shunts. Catalog-only pairs have qty0 and are not DNP sites; analog and power sheets own their fitted quantities. Control gates, receiving-domain Ioff buffers and CS ADC protection are on other sheets.
footprint_status: Names are intended library identifiers; no KiCad assets are asserted to exist. Every IC physical pin, custom isolated package, relay bottom-view transformation, connector orientation and passive land pattern remains a capture comparison gate.
source_policy: Electrical limits use manufacturer documents. A family code or calculated suitability is distinguished from a downloaded exact reference sheet in evidence. Current distributor stock and pricing are not checked.
